execution_paths.name: Scoring to Alert Generation and Persistence
execution_paths.state_mutation: Creates new Alert record with risk_score, severity, reason_codes, triage_priority
execution_paths.external_side_effects: Background intelligence sharing if enabled; optional WebhookService.dispatch_event
execution_paths.retry_behavior: Sliding-window deduplication (300s window) escalates risk_score and dedup_count rather than creating duplicate row
execution_paths.failure_behavior: Rolls back / logs warning; fails closed

execution_paths.name: Case Creation and Idempotency
execution_paths.state_mutation: Initializes Case in OPEN status with cryptographic genesis timeline block
execution_paths.retry_behavior: IdempotencyService (24h bounded cache with SHA-256 payload hash match check)
execution_paths.failure_behavior: HTTP 409 on concurrent in-progress or payload conflict; HTTP 422 on invalid schema

execution_paths.name: Investigation, Assignment, and State Progression
execution_paths.state_mutation: Mutates case.status according to CASE_STATE_TRANSITIONS, appends to hash-chained timeline
execution_paths.retry_behavior: Optimistic concurrency via expected_status precondition; returns HTTP 409 on mismatch
execution_paths.failure_behavior: HTTP 400 on illegal transition, HTTP 409 on race conflict, HTTP 403 on cross-tenant access

execution_paths.name: Four-Eyes Dual Control Supervisor Signoff and Resolution
execution_paths.state_mutation: Transitions case to CLOSED_CONFIRMED or CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE; sets closed_at timestamp
execution_paths.retry_behavior: Terminal states strictly immutable; subsequent transition attempts raise TerminalCaseImmutableError
execution_paths.failure_behavior: HTTP 403 on self-approval attempt; HTTP 400 on duplicate supervisor or missing second signature

execution_paths.name: FinCEN BSA SAR 2.0 XML Generation and Packaging
execution_paths.state_mutation: Compiles XML, validates structure/XSD, generates SHA-256 seal, caches filing record
execution_paths.external_side_effects: Local file creation only (Export/Preparation). No external FIU gateway submission
execution_paths.case_identity: case_id (requires confirmed fraud or escalated state; rejected on false positive)
execution_paths.retry_behavior: Overwrites/regenerates XML on disk atomically using temp file; maintains same filing identity
execution_paths.failure_behavior: HTTP 400 if case is CLOSED_FALSE_POSITIVE or unreviewed OPEN/ASSIGNED; HTTP 400 on SARValidationError
execution_paths.frontend_consumer: CaseDetailPage.tsx (Download XML button, SAR package viewer)

execution_paths.name: Developer Webhook Notification Dispatch
execution_paths.state_mutation: Computes HMAC-SHA256 signature, delivers payload asynchronously via httpx
execution_paths.authorization_boundary: SSRF target URL validation (DNS resolution check, private IP block, loopback block)
execution_paths.retry_behavior: Idempotent external delivery contract: retries carry identical X-CFI-Event-Id header
execution_paths.failure_behavior: Logs warning on delivery timeout/refusal; does not block caller business transaction
